name: Chennai
desc: Serving families and business owners across Chennai, Tamil Nadu, Insurance Support offers independent, IRDAI-certified consultancy. From high-sum-assured term plans to family floater health policies, we help you secure the right coverage with full claim recovery backup.
it_focus: Comprehensive health and term insurance for OMR IT corridor employees at Sholinganallur, Tidel Park, and DLF Cyber City.
senior_focus: Doorstep LIC policy servicing and cashless claim support for senior residents of Mylapore, Adyar, and T Nagar.
branch_dets: Direct liaison with LIC Zonal Office at Anna Salai and private insurer branches on OMR and T Nagar.

local_faqs.question: Which hospitals in Chennai are covered for cashless treatment?
local_faqs.answer: Apollo Hospitals Greams Road, Fortis Malar, MIOT International, Kauvery Hospital, and SIMS Hospital are all in our cashless network.

local_faqs.question: Can you help IT employees on OMR with group health insurance?
local_faqs.answer: Yes, we structuring group mediclaim, personal accident, and corporate health plans for startups and IT companies along OMR and Sholinganallur.
